name: Period Operator
summary: Finalizes bounded periods into stable records with deterministic keys and normalized boundary facts.
description: Uses period.finalize to normalize one bounded period into a deterministic finalized record with explicit start, end, closure state, and idempotency key. Needs stable period-close outputs without embedding any application-specific workflow routing into the capability.

distinguished_from.how: Needs normalized finalized period records and closure keys, rather than aggregates computed over references inside a completed period.
Finalizes one bounded period record, rather than assessing whether a coverage window is complete, partial, or unavailable.
